# GitHub CLI Linux package signing key expires September 5

## What Changed

The current PGP key for the GitHub CLI Linux package repositories expires on Saturday, September 5, 2026. Beginning with the first release after that date, APT and RPM repository metadata…

This can create a customer delivery blocker or migration requirement.
